description: F-THREAD-04 — M10 × 1.5 LEFT-HAND geometric thread. Verifies that the LH flip is applied to the helix winding (sin sign inverted) and that the callout suffix carries 'LH' before the depth marker.
notes: M10 coarse pitch 1.5 mm × 15 mm length = exactly 10 turns.
Left-hand → sin sign flipped in helix sample equation (helixGeometry.ts).
Looking down from +Z, the LH helix winds CW (right-hand winds CCW).
Callout 'M10-6g LH ↧ 15' — LH appears between class and depth (ISO 6410-1).
Helix z-coordinate still increases monotonically; LH does NOT reverse the axial direction.
